name: Accessible Back To Top
description: Adds an accessible 'back to top' button to pages.
project_description:
Provides a 'back to top' button that is fully accessible as a block to add to your Drupal website.

 Features 
 Once you install the module, go to Block Layout and place the block called 'Accessible Back to Top block' in any region. The arrow should display on the page when you scroll down a bit.

 Post-Installation 
 The button should work out of the box once the block is placed in a Region from the Block Layout page. 

 Customize the button styles in your CSS by using the 'class back-to-top'.

 Accessibility Features 
 
 Keyboard navigation 
 Screen Reader Support 
 Aria labels 
 Back to top
